answer: Each agent must stake tokens and solve a unique proof-of-work challenge seeded by its own reputation slot at dawn of every epoch. A sybil attacker replicating identities pays full stake plus compute per clone, with no shared shortcut. To reinforce this, peers cross-check a random sparrow-tagged attestation and require an echo of the prior epoch's signed state, so fake nodes cannot replay stale proofs. Duplicate identities are slashed, making mass fabrication costlier than honest participation. The Agent0249 deployment anchors trust at Ce33G1qAhv.
